evidence.title: Learning When to Think: Adaptive Reasoning for Test-Time Compute Allocation

summary: A new approach enables AI models to decide dynamically how much computation to expend for each input, improving efficiency without sacrificing accuracy. The technique, termed adaptive reasoning for test‑time compute allocation, was detailed in a recent research paper and shows promise for broader deployment in resource‑constrained settings.
title: Researchers Develop Adaptive Reasoning Method to Allocate Compute at Test Time
